title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks reused by every v1 data file. Encodings follow the C2SP specs for tree hashes (base64) and sha256sum for file digests (lowercase hex).

logName.description: Short name of a transparency log, as used in paths (data/v1/<log>/...). The names cia, index, timestamps and witnesses are reserved.

origin.description: Checkpoint origin line (C2SP tlog-checkpoint), e.g. transparency.diagnos.health/audit/v1.

keyName.description: Signed-note key name: no spaces and no '+'.

keyHash.description: Signed-note key ID: the first 4 bytes of SHA-256(name || 0x0A || alg || pubkey), as 8 lowercase hex digits.

logUrl.description: Public read URL of a tlog-tiles log, with a trailing slash.

time.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC with second precision.

treeSize.description: Number of leaves in a Merkle tree. Kept below 2^53 so that every JSON reader gets the exact value.

treeHash.description: A 32-byte SHA-256 Merkle tree hash in standard base64, exactly as it appears in a checkpoint.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of some bytes in lowercase hex, as printed by sha256sum.

oid.description: An ASN.1 object identifier in dotted form.

provider.description: Short name of an RFC 3161 time-stamping authority. Its CA chain is published at keys/tsa/<provider>.pem.

witnessPath.description: Repository path of a witness record; the file name is the UTC time of the cosignature. The primary witness's records are under data/v1/<log>/witness/; every other witness's are under data/v1/witnesses/<witness>/<log>/witness/.

findingPath.description: Repository path of a finding record, under the same namespace as the witness that found it.

timestampPath.description: Repository path of an hourly timestamp record.

tokenPath.description: Repository path of a raw RFC 3161 TimeStampResp (DER).

signedNote.description: The exact text of a C2SP signed note: a body ending in a newline, a blank line, then one or more signature lines '— <name> <base64>' each ending in a newline.

treeHead.description: A tree size and the root hash at that size.

consistencyProof.description: RFC 9162 section 2.1.4 consistency proof, as base64 tree hashes. At most 2*64 nodes.

findingKind.description: equivocation: two log-signed checkpoints with the same size and different roots. rollback: a log-signed checkpoint smaller than one already witnessed. inconsistent: a larger checkpoint whose consistency proof does not verify.

findingSummary.description: A finding as listed by latest.json and the month index.

serviceId.description: Short, stable name of an audited service, as used in paths and in /healthz (frontend, vault, sign, status).

serviceUrl.description: Base URL of an audited service: https, a host, and a single trailing slash.

dimension.description: One of the three audited properties.

level.description: ok: the check passed. warn: degraded, or the auditor could not confirm. fail: the check failed or there is evidence of a problem. none: not measured.

slot.description: The start of a five-minute slot: a UTC instant whose minutes are a multiple of five and whose seconds are zero.

dayLetters.description: One letter per five-minute slot of a UTC day (288): o ok, w warn, f fail, - none or not measured.

dayRuns.description: One digit per five-minute slot of a UTC day (288): 1 if the auditor recorded a run in that slot, 0 if not.

windowLetters.description: One letter per UTC day of a 90-day window, oldest first: o ok, w warn, f fail, - none or not measured.

gitCommit.description: A full Git commit hash (SHA-1), lowercase hex.

gitBlob.description: A Git blob hash (SHA-1) as GitHub reports it, lowercase hex.

version.description: A release version as the service reports it (semantic version, optionally with build metadata).

incidentId.description: Identifier of a declared incident: the declaration date and a slug (which must not start with "auto-", that is for the incidents the auditor opens itself). It is also the file name, incidents/<id>.md. The incidents of both kinds are told apart by their source.

autoIncidentId.description: Identifier of an incident the auditor opened on its own: the UTC day of the first slot of the problem, "auto", the service, the category (a availability, i integrity) and the time of that slot (HHMM), e.g. 2026-10-01-auto-vault-a-0310. It is also the prefix of the file names of its event facts. A declared incident may not use a slug that starts with "auto-".

incidentCategory.description: What an incident is about: C confidentiality, I integrity, A availability. An incident colours the dimensions of its categories on the services it affects.

incidentCategories.description: A non-empty set of incident categories, always written in the order C, I, A.

incidentSeverity.description: low and medium colour the affected dimension yellow; high and critical, red.

ciaIncidentEventPath.description: Repository path of one event of an automatic incident: <incident id>-<seq>.json under the UTC day of the run that wrote it.

localizedText.description: The same plain text in English and Brazilian Portuguese.

ciaRunPath.description: Repository path of a CIA run record; the file name is the slot (HHMM, UTC).

ciaIncidentsPath.description: Repository path of an incidents snapshot; the file name is the slot (HHMM, UTC) of the run that read it.

releaseVerdictPath.description: Repository path of the auditor's verdict on one release of one service, under the release's manifest digest.

releaseFilePath.description: Repository path of a piece of release evidence archived by the auditor.

ciaRunLink.description: A CIA run record and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

ciaIncidentsLink.description: An incidents snapshot and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

checkCode.description: Machine-readable reason of a check result. The allowed values per check are listed in cia-run.schema.json.

witnessId.description: A witness, named after the region it measures from: europe (the primary witness, in Paris) or latam (the secondary witness, in Sao Paulo). People see Europe / Europa and Latin America / America Latina.

vantage.description: Where a witness ran, as provider:region (scaleway:fr-par, oci:sa-saopaulo-1).

errorClass.description: The phase in which an attempt failed, first that applies: dns (name resolution), connect (TCP), tls (handshake or certificate), timeout (connected, but the response or its body did not arrive before the attempt's deadline), http-5xx and http-4xx (the status), assertion (a complete response that broke a rule of the check: another status, media type, body, service or environment).

probeTimings.description: Where the time of the deciding attempt went, in whole milliseconds measured on a monotonic clock. The phases do not overlap: dnsMs resolves the name, connectMs opens the TCP connection, tlsMs is the TLS handshake, waitMs runs from the request written to the first byte of the response, transferMs from that byte to the end of the body. A phase that did not happen or did not finish is null. totalMs is the whole attempt, from its start to the end of the body or to the failure, and is at least the sum of the phases. Time to first byte is totalMs minus transferMs.

probe.description: One witness's GET <url>healthz of one service in one run, on a fresh IPv4 connection (no reuse, no proxy, no redirect followed), with one retry 2 s later after a timeout, a connection error or HTTP 5xx/429. The fields describe the attempt that decided the result.

code.description: The result, with the level of the check table (ok, retried: ok; slow, tls-expiring: warn; challenged, vantage: none; the rest: fail).

class.description: The error class of the deciding attempt; null when it succeeded, and for challenged and vantage.

retriedAfter.description: With two attempts, the error class of the first one; else null.

tlsIssuer.description: The common name, or else the organization, of the issuer of the leaf certificate.

ip.description: The address the connection was made to. Probes dial IPv4 only.

edge.description: The IATA code of the CDN location that answered, as named by the CDN in its response headers; null when the response names none.

bytes.description: Size of the response body that was read.

witnessControl.description: The witness's control probe: a request to a host outside diagnos. When it failed and every probe of this witness failed at the transport level, the witness's own network failed: its probes and log checks carry the code vantage (not measured).

witnessLog.description: What one witness did with one transparency log in this run.

code.description: Level as in the check table: ok ok; log-error warn; finding, halted fail; unreachable, vantage none.

root.description: The root of the checkpoint the witness read in this run; null when it read none (or the log is halted).

record.description: The witness's latest witness record of this log.

witnessPeer.description: The secondary witness's check of the latest run record the primary published, read before measuring: ok (the europe section's signature verifies and the record links the record this witness checked before), gap (it verifies, but the record it checked before is not the previous one, so the link was not checked), mismatch (a signature fails, or the link does not match: the published history changed), unavailable (it could not be read). record and sha256 name the run record it read and the SHA-256 of the bytes it read; they are null only for unavailable.

witnessMeasured.description: Everything one witness measured in one run. Signed by the witness: see witnessEntry.note.

witnessEntry.description: One witness in one run: its signed measurement, or why it is missing. A missing witness is not measured (grey), never an outage.

reason.description: Why the measurement is missing: timeout (no answer in time, after one retry), unreachable (no connection), rejected (the witness refused the request), signature (the answer did not verify), invalid (the answer broke the contract), skew (its clock was more than 60 s off), off (not configured). null when status is ok.

note.description: The witness's signed note over this measurement. Its text is five lines: 'diagnos-witness/measurement/v1', 'witness <id>', 'slot <slot>', 'request <SHA-256 of the request note that asked for it, or none>', 'measured <SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of measured>'. The key is one of the witness's keys in keys/witness/<id>.vkey, the current one or a key it replaced (the Ed25519 public key of its cosignature key, as a signed-note key); the note names the one that signed it.

latencyStats.description: Latency of the successful probes of one witness over one day. Percentiles are nearest rank (the value at position ceil(p * n / 100) of the n sorted values; minMs is p0 and maxMs p100), meanMs is the mean rounded half up; all null when samples is 0. Failed probes, including timeouts, are not latency samples: they are counted in errors.

slotsMs.description: totalMs of the witness's probe in slot i when it succeeded (ok, retried, slow, tls-expiring), else null. Exactly 288 entries.

phaseStats.description: One timing phase over the day's successful probes where it was measured: mean (rounded half up) and nearest-rank percentiles.

errorCounts.description: Slots of the day whose probe failed, by the error class of the deciding attempt.

uptime.description: Slots at ok or warn, and slots at ok, warn or fail.
